dek.zh: 前线将领当面许下封赏，一位外国将领在旁作保，城门因此打开。等到对方上门要求兑现，这份承诺该算谁的？
dek.en: A field commander promised rewards face to face, a foreign officer stood guarantor, and the city gates opened. When the other side came to collect, whose promise was it to keep?

paras.zh: 同治二年十月，官军已经攻破苏州外郭，守将李秀成、谭绍洸退进内城死守。官军从水陆三面合围，城里粮食吃完了，人心开始动摇。守军中的下级将领郜云官等人，向城外的官军将领程学启通款，请求投降。
paras.en: In the tenth month of the second year of the Tongzhi reign, government forces had broken through the outer walls of Suzhou. Two of the city's commanders, Li Xiucheng and Tan Shaoguang, fell back into the inner city and held on. The besiegers closed in from three sides, by land and by water. Inside, the food ran out and the garrison's resolve began to waver. Gao Yunguan and other subordinate commanders among the defenders made overtures to Cheng Xueqi, a general on the government side outside the walls, offering to surrender.

paras.zh: 投降不是递一句话就完的事。城里的郜云官要拿什么来换，换回什么，又凭什么相信对方会守约，都得当面谈清楚。这份降约怎么谈、靠什么让人相信，后来成了整件事的关键。
paras.en: A surrender is not settled with a single message. Gao Yunguan needed to know what he would have to hand over, what he would receive in return, and why he should believe the other side would keep its word. All of it had to be agreed in person. How that pact was negotiated, and what made it believable, became the crux of everything that followed.

paras.zh: 程学启是李鸿章手下的前线将领。同在苏州城下的，还有一支特别的队伍，叫常胜军。它最初由美国人华尔在上海招募训练，几十名欧美人加上几百名中国应募者。这支队伍屡次以少胜多，官军和敌军都管它叫常胜军。
paras.en: Cheng Xueqi was one of Li Hongzhang's field commanders. Also before the walls of Suzhou was an unusual force known as the Ever-Victorious Army. An American named Ward had first recruited and drilled it in Shanghai: a few dozen Europeans and Americans, joined by several hundred Chinese volunteers. It beat larger forces again and again, and both the government troops and their enemies came to call it the Ever-Victorious Army.

paras.zh: 李鸿章的淮军刚到上海时，西方人看到他们衣帽粗陋，暗中嘲笑。李鸿章对身边的人说「軍之良窳，豈在服制耶」，意思是：军队好坏，难道在于穿什么吗？这句反问是对嘲笑的回应。他接着说，等对方见识了淮军大将的旗鼓，自然会有定论。后来欧美人看到淮军将校勇敢、纪律严整，都改了态度，常胜军也开始服从李鸿章的调度。
paras.en: When Li Hongzhang's Huai Army first arrived in Shanghai, Westerners laughed behind their hands at the soldiers' rough clothes and caps. Li Hongzhang asked the men around him, in effect, whether an army's quality was to be judged by its uniforms. The rhetorical question was his reply to the mockery. Let them see the banners and drums of our generals, he went on, and they will reach their own verdict. In time the Europeans and Americans saw how brave the Huai officers were and how strict their discipline, and their attitude changed. The Ever-Victorious Army, too, began to accept Li Hongzhang's command.

paras.zh: 华尔死后，继任统领白齐文向上海道台杨坊勒索巨额军资，没有得手，就殴打杨坊，抢走四万两银子。李鸿章大怒，与英国领事交涉，撤掉白齐文，改由英国将官戈登代领常胜军。那是同治二年二月。也就是说，戈登是在李鸿章与英方交涉之后，才接手这支队伍的。
paras.en: After Ward's death, his successor, Burgevine, demanded an enormous sum for military funds from Yang Fang, the circuit intendant, or daotai, of Shanghai. When the money did not come, Burgevine beat Yang Fang and carried off forty thousand taels of silver. Li Hongzhang was furious. He took the matter up with the British consul, had Burgevine removed, and put a British officer, Gordon, in command of the Ever-Victorious Army in his place. That was the second month of the same year. Gordon, in other words, took over the force only after Li Hongzhang had negotiated with the British.

paras.zh: 当年三月，官军收复太仓、昆山，程学启功劳最大。梁启超在《李鸿章传》里记载，戈登从此更加敬服程学启。六月，程学启率水陆一万多人，与刘铭传一起谋取苏州。此后他在苏州附近连日苦战，宝带桥、虎邱等十余处营垒相继被攻破，淮军名声大振。
paras.en: In the third month, government forces retook Taicang and Kunshan, with Cheng Xueqi doing the most to win them. Liang Qichao, in his biography of Li Hongzhang, records that from then on Gordon held Cheng in ever greater respect. In the sixth month, Cheng led more than 10,000 men on land and water and laid plans with Liu Mingchuan to recover Suzhou. Fighting hard near the city day after day, he took more than ten fortified positions in turn, among them those at Baodai Bridge and Tiger Hill. The Huai Army's reputation soared.

paras.zh: 李秀成派部将纠合无锡、溧阳、宜兴等处八万多人、一千多条船，出运河口；自己率精锐数千人据守金匮，回援苏州。两路互相策应，与官军连战，互有胜负。十月十九日，李鸿章亲自督军，程学启和戈登担任先锋，苦战后攻破外郭。李秀成和谭绍洸退入内城，死守不屈。
paras.en: Li Xiucheng sent his subordinate commanders to gather more than eighty thousand men from Wuxi, Liyang, Yixing and elsewhere, with over a thousand boats, out to the mouth of the Grand Canal, while he himself took several thousand picked troops to hold Jinkui and relieve Suzhou. The two forces supported each other and clashed repeatedly with the government side, each winning some and losing some. On the nineteenth day of the tenth month, with Li Hongzhang directing the attack in person and Cheng Xueqi and Gordon leading the vanguard, the government forces fought their way through the outer walls. Li Xiucheng and Tan Shaoguang withdrew into the inner city and refused to yield.

heading.en: A Pact on the Lake, a Banquet on the Ship

paras.zh: 郜云官乞降之后，程学启和戈登亲自乘小船到城北的阳澄湖，与郜云官等人当面订约。城外一方提出的条件是：杀掉李秀成、谭绍洸，把首级献上来；作为交换，许给二品的封赏。戈登是这份约定的保人。梁启超紧接着写了一句「戈登爲之保人，故云官等不疑」：因为有戈登作保，郜云官等人才没有疑心。按梁启超的写法，降将肯信这份约，靠的是戈登的担保。
paras.en: After Gao Yunguan's offer reached him, Cheng Xueqi went with Gordon by small boat to Yangcheng Lake, north of the city, to settle terms face to face with Gao and his fellow commanders. The terms put to them were these: kill Li Xiucheng and Tan Shaoguang and deliver their heads, and in return receive rewards of the second rank. Gordon acted as guarantor. Liang's next line, in translation, is that because Gordon stood as their guarantor, Gao Yunguan and the others had no doubts. As Liang tells it, what made the defectors trust the pact was Gordon's guarantee.

paras.zh: 约定并没有被全盘接受。「然卒不忍害秀成，乃許斬紹洸而別」，意思是郜云官等人终究不忍心加害李秀成，只答应斩杀谭绍洸，然后散去。这是降约里的一次让步：城外要两个人的首级，降将只肯交出一个。
paras.en: The terms were not accepted in full. Liang writes that in the end Gao Yunguan and the others could not bear to harm Li Xiucheng; they agreed only to behead Tan Shaoguang, and so they parted. This was a concession within the pact. The men outside the walls had asked for two heads, and the defectors would deliver only one.

paras.zh: 李秀成隐约察觉了这个计划，但事已至此，无可奈何，便趁夜出城离开。二十四日，谭绍洸因事把郜云官召进帐中。郜云官带着骁将汪有为一同前去，一见面就刺死了谭绍洸，又袭击谭绍洸的亲军一千多人，随后打开城门投降。
paras.en: Li Xiucheng sensed something of the plot, but by then there was nothing he could do, and he slipped out of the city by night. On the twenty-fourth, Tan Shaoguang summoned Gao Yunguan to his tent on some business. Gao went, taking with him Wang Youwei, a fierce fighter, and the moment he came before Tan he stabbed him to death. Gao's men then fell on Tan's personal guard of more than a thousand, and the gates were opened in surrender.

paras.zh: 二十五日，郜云官等人献上谭绍洸的首级，请程学启进城验看。书中列出了这批降将的名号：纳王郜云官、比王伍贵文、康王汪安均、宁王周文佳，以及天将军范起发、张大洲、汪环武、汪有为，四位王、四位天将军，一共八人。
paras.en: On the twenty-fifth, Gao Yunguan and the others presented Tan Shaoguang's head and invited Cheng Xueqi into the city to inspect it. Liang lists the surrendering leaders by the titles they held among the defenders: Gao Yunguan, King Na; Wu Guiwen, King Bi; Wang Anjun, King Kang; Zhou Wenjia, King Ning; and four Heavenly Generals, Fan Qifa, Zhang Dazhou, Wang Huanwu and Wang Youwei. Four kings and four Heavenly Generals: eight men in all.

paras.zh: 城门开了，事情却没有结束。这八人的部下还有十几万人留在城中，梁启超形容为「聲勢洶洶」，意思是来势汹汹、气势逼人。程学启先前许过他们总兵、副将等官职，这时八人「求如約」，要求按约兑现。降约的前半段，是降将开门、献首级；现在轮到许诺的一方了。
paras.en: The gates were open, but the matter was not closed. More than a hundred thousand of these eight men's troops were still inside the city, a force Liang describes as menacing, pressing and full of threat. Cheng Xueqi had earlier promised the eight posts such as brigade general and deputy general, and now they asked that the agreement be honoured. The defectors had done their part: they had opened the gates and handed over a head. It was now the turn of the side that had made the promises.

paras.zh: 梁启超记下了程学启对这八个人的判断：「謂狼子野心，恐後不可制」，说他们像狼崽子一样野心难驯，将来恐怕控制不住。这是书中给出的理由。于是程学启与李鸿章秘密商议，在座舰上大摆宴席款待八人。「號炮一響，伏兵起而駢戮之」，号炮一响，埋伏的士兵冲出来，把八人一并杀死。他们的余党中，强行抵抗的一千多人也被杀，其余部众全部投降。苏州平定，李鸿章因功加太子少保。
paras.en: Liang records Cheng Xueqi's judgment of the eight: in translation, he judged them wolf cubs at heart and feared they could not be controlled later, untameably ambitious men who might slip out of his grip. That is the reason the book gives. Cheng then plotted in secret with Li Hongzhang, and the eight were invited to a lavish banquet aboard a ship. When the signal gun sounded, the hidden soldiers rose and killed all eight together. More than a thousand of their followers who tried to resist were killed as well, and the rest of their troops surrendered. With Suzhou pacified, Li Hongzhang was rewarded with the honorary title Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

paras.zh: 现在回到戈登。八人投降时，他正是阳澄湖降约的保人。梁启超写他「聞鴻章之食言也，大怒」：听说李鸿章不守诺言，戈登勃然大怒，想杀李鸿章抵罪，「自攜短銃以覓之」，亲自带着短枪去找李鸿章。「鴻章避之，不敢歸營」，李鸿章躲开了，不敢回营。几天后，戈登的怒气渐渐消了，这才作罢。梁启超对此评论说，李鸿章在这件事上「有慚德」，也就是有愧于心。他列出三重罪过：杀降违背公理，背约食言，欺骗了身为朋友的戈登。在梁启超看来，戈登恨到想动刀泄愤，是理所当然的。他也承认，李鸿章或许鉴于苗沛霖、李世忠的旧事，有不得已之处，但认为这件事正可见李鸿章一生好用小聪明、小手段。
paras.en: Now return to Gordon. When the eight surrendered, he had been the guarantor of the pact made on Yangcheng Lake. Liang writes, in effect, that when Gordon heard Li Hongzhang had broken his word, he was enraged. Gordon wanted to kill Li Hongzhang to make him pay, and went looking for him with a pistol himself. Li Hongzhang kept out of his way and dared not return to camp. After a few days Gordon's anger slowly cooled, and he let the matter drop. Liang then comments that Li Hongzhang had cause for shame here. He lists three offences: killing men who had surrendered violated what is right; Li Hongzhang broke the agreement and went back on his word; and he deceived Gordon, wronging a friend. In Liang's view, Gordon's fury, to the point of wanting to stab him, was only to be expected. Liang allows that Li Hongzhang may have had the earlier cases of Miao Peilin and Li Shizhong in mind and acted partly out of necessity, but he holds that the episode shows Li Hongzhang's lifelong fondness for petty cleverness and small tricks.

paras.zh: 这件事之后，常胜军仍与淮军一同作战：刘铭传、郭松林等人率部与常胜军共同进攻常州一带，攻克宜兴、荆溪，擒获敌将黄靖忠。
paras.en: After this, the Ever-Victorious Army still fought alongside the Huai Army: Liu Mingchuan, Guo Songlin and other commanders led their troops with it against Changzhou and the surrounding area, taking Yixing and Jingxi and capturing the enemy commander Huang Jingzhong.

heading.zh: 许诺、作保、兑现，落在三个人身上
heading.en: Promise, Guarantee, Payment: Three Different Men

paras.zh: 把这件事拆开看，降约里有三个角色。许诺的是程学启：湖上与降将订约的是他和戈登，许以总兵、副将等职的是他；作保的是戈登，书中明说降将「不疑」是因为他；决定不兑现的，是程学启与李鸿章的密谋。值得注意的是，主意出自程学启的判断，戈登去找的却是李鸿章，书里用的词也是「鴻章之食言」；梁启超在评论里也把背约食言、欺骗戈登算作李鸿章的罪过。一种解释是：在戈登看来，前线将领的许诺代表的是统帅；统帅点头杀降，就等于统帅本人食言。许诺可以由前线作出，兑现与否却要由上面来担。
paras.en: Take the episode apart and the pact had three roles. Cheng Xueqi made the promise: he and Gordon settled terms with the defectors on the lake, and it was Cheng who promised them posts such as brigade general and deputy general. Gordon guaranteed it, and the book says plainly that the defectors had no doubts because of him. The decision not to pay came from the secret plan between Cheng and Li Hongzhang. Yet the idea grew out of Cheng's judgment, while the man Gordon went hunting for was Li Hongzhang, and the book's own phrase is that Hongzhang had broken his word; in his commentary, Liang also counts breaking the agreement and deceiving Gordon among Li Hongzhang's offences. One reading is that, to Gordon, a field commander's promise spoke for his superior; once the superior agreed to kill men who had surrendered, the broken word was his. Promises may be made at the front, but whether they are kept is answered higher up.

paras.zh: 第二层是保人的处境。书中写戈登是「聞」，本文据此推测，他是事后才听说这件事的。降将因为他才不起疑；降将被杀，他作保的那句话也跟着落空。
paras.en: The second layer is the guarantor's position. The book says Gordon heard of it; this article infers from that word that he learned of it after the fact. The defectors had trusted the pact because of him; when they were killed, his word as guarantor fell with them.

paras.zh: 第三层是程学启的理由。十几万部众、「聲勢洶洶」、「狼子野心」，书中给出的是一笔控制风险的账。
paras.en: The third layer is Cheng Xueqi's reasoning. More than a hundred thousand troops, a menacing presence, men he judged wolf cubs at heart: what the book sets out is a calculation about controlling risk.

paras.zh: 代价也分两笔。眼前那笔很清楚：苏州到手，李鸿章加衔。长远那笔，本文依据的记载写到：李鸿章躲了几天，戈登怒气消退，常胜军之后仍与淮军并肩作战；梁启超则在评论中认定此举有愧。后来的合作也不能证明这一步做对了，只能说明这道裂痕没有让双方当场决裂。如果承诺的风险真的太大，本文提出两种可能的做法：许诺之前先请统帅定好权限，反悔之前先和保人商量。这两种做法都是本文的假设。
paras.en: The costs fall into two accounts. The immediate one is plain: Suzhou was taken and Li Hongzhang received a new title. Of the longer account, the material this article draws on records that Li Hongzhang stayed out of sight for a few days, Gordon's anger subsided, and the Ever-Victorious Army went on fighting beside the Huai Army; Liang, for his part, judges in his commentary that the act was cause for shame. Their later cooperation does not prove the decision was right; it shows only that the rift did not break them apart on the spot. If honouring the promise really carried too great a risk, this article suggests two other courses: before promising, agree with the commander-in-chief on the limits of what may be offered; before going back on the promise, consult the guarantor. Both are this article's own hypotheses.

heading.zh: 这份记载能告诉我们多少
heading.en: How Much This Account Can Tell Us

paras.zh: 本文只依据梁启超《李鸿章传》一部书。这部书以李鸿章为中心，降将一方和戈登本人的说法都没有进入证据。许诺的内容有两种说法：湖上订约时是“二品之赏”，城破后降将要求兑现的是“总兵副将等职”，本文无法判断两者的关系。十几万部众、一千多余党等数字，都取自这部书，本文未与其他记载核对。
paras.en: This article rests on a single book, Liang Qichao's biography of Li Hongzhang. The book centres on Li Hongzhang; neither the defectors' version nor Gordon's own account is among the evidence. The promise is also described in two ways: at the lake it was rewards of the second rank, while after the city fell the defectors asked for posts such as brigade general and deputy general. This article cannot determine how the two relate. The figures of more than a hundred thousand troops and more than a thousand followers killed are taken from this book and have not been checked against other records.

scenario.zh: 小周是公司派驻外地的业务负责人。为了拿下一家代理商，他当面答应对方：签约后给区域独家权，外加一年返点。对方还在犹豫，小周请来长期合作的物流伙伴老陈出面作保，对方这才签字。渠道打开后，总部评估认为这家代理商实力太强，将来难以约束，决定不给独家权。那次见面的纪要上，还写着老陈的名字。
scenario.en: Zhou runs his company's business in a city far from head office. To win over a distributor, he promised its owners in person: once they signed, they would get exclusive rights in the region plus a year of rebates. The distributor still hesitated, so Zhou asked Chen, a logistics partner the company had worked with for years, to vouch for the deal, and only then did the distributor sign. With the channel open, head office concluded that the distributor was too strong and would be hard to keep in line later, and decided not to grant exclusivity. The notes from that meeting still carry Chen's name.

question.zh: 如果你是总部负责人，一边是反悔带来的可控，一边是小周和老陈的信用，你会怎么决定？这次承诺的后果，应该由谁来承担？
question.en: If you ran head office, how would you weigh the control gained by going back on the deal against the credibility of Zhou and Chen? And who should bear the consequences of this promise?

assumptions.zh: 假设小周的许诺超出了他的书面权限，但总部事前默许他去谈；老陈作保没有拿任何好处。
assumptions.en: Assume Zhou's promise went beyond his written authority, but head office had tacitly let him negotiate; Chen received nothing for vouching.

steps.zh:
先分清承诺属于谁：总部既然默许小周去谈，对外就很难说这只是小周个人的话。
再看风险是否只能靠反悔来化解，能否改用合同条款、考核门槛或分期授权来约束代理商。
如果确实要调整，先找老陈说明原因，听取他的意见，再由总部出面向代理商解释，并给出替代补偿，不让小周和老陈独自面对对方。
steps.en: 1. First settle whose promise it was: since head office let Zhou negotiate, it is hard to tell outsiders that this was only Zhou's personal word. 2. Then ask whether the risk can only be handled by reneging, or whether contract terms, performance thresholds or rights granted in stages could keep the distributor in check. 3. If an adjustment really is needed, go to Chen first, explain why and hear his view; then have head office itself explain to the distributor and offer alternative compensation, so that Zhou and Chen are not left to face the distributor alone.

alternative.zh: 另一种判断是：既然有当面许诺、又有保人，总部应先兑现，再通过续约条件约束对方。代价是总部要自己承担那份担心的风险，换来的是前线和合作伙伴今后还敢替公司开口。
alternative.en: Another view: with a promise made in person and a guarantor behind it, head office should honour the deal first and use renewal terms to keep the distributor in line. The price is that head office carries the risk it is worried about; the gain is that its front-line staff and partners will still be willing to speak for the company in future.

uncertainty_note.zh: 全文只依据梁启超《李鸿章传》一种记载，缺少降将一方和戈登本人的叙述；许诺内容的两种表述之间是什么关系不明，文中数字均取自这部书，未另行核对。
uncertainty_note.en: The whole article relies on a single account, Liang Qichao's biography of Li Hongzhang, and lacks any narrative from the defectors or from Gordon himself; how the two descriptions of the promise relate is unclear, and the figures cited are taken from this book and have not been checked elsewhere.

preheader.zh: 城門是靠一份有保人的降約打開的，城破之後，這份約卻沒有兌現。
preheader.en: The city gates opened on a guaranteed surrender pact; once the city fell, the pact was broken.

episode.action: 蘇州守將郜雲官等八人在程學啟許官、戈登作保之下殺譚紹洸開城投降，李鴻章與程學啟隨後密謀設宴將八人殺死，背棄了降約。
